title: pipeline.py: TilePipeline (placeholder+live encoders, warm-live, splice)
description: Spawns placeholder + live encoders, warm-live greenlet (Dispatcharr init via realsrc, scan live stdout for first random-access keyframe, signal ready), drives the splice, yields continuous tile TS. Teardown in finally. On drop: splice to offline card and stay (no live retry in v1).

title: server.py seamless multiview rebuild
description:
Rebuild the streaming core of src/server.py so the multiview composite starts instantly with channel logos and each tile seamlessly swaps its placeholder for live video, never stalling the composite. Architecture: per-tile persistent encoder + broadcast-style identical-param TS splice at a keyframe. Composition reads N always-on normalized tile streams. Plan: ~/.claude/plans/indexed-mixing-moth.md

## Context
Survivor of a buggy rebuild (HEAD 8ed2161 'blow it all up'). Old failures: gevent/ffmpeg stdout bridging churn, and xstack stall from byte-splicing different-parameter TS. config.py/layouts.py/epg.py/__init__.py stay untouched.

title: Auto-reconnect: re-splice a dropped tile back to live on recovery
description: v1 leaves a dropped tile on the offline card. Future work: detect when a dropped channel's source recovers and seamlessly re-splice the tile back to live (the 'reconnect down the road'). Design the recovery detection + re-warm + re-splice path.

title: [Feature]: Regex Multiview Building
description:
### What problem does this solve?

Event channels come and go, and can't be reliably or reasonably selected by the dropdown.

### Proposed solution

Allow a type selector of classic/regex to each multi view (different fields, refresh plugins to change up) - regex dynamically grabs channels that match a regex pattern, up to the limit configured (ie 4) so that we don't go insane. audio selection on regex type should either be FIRST matched, LOWEST channel number, or ALL.
